answer: A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. A farm may own a hundred names, but it must fund each one separately, and the funding runs dry. Every entry must show Beaconbound oil merchant lantern warrant before the ledger opens, because a warrant oil merchants show after oil store trials. Before the stamp comes a toll of 33 credits, collected in coin before the name is written down, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. The clerk notes comet. The saffron is on the docket. One haven, one entry.
